notebooks.title: Count synthetic contribution records without counting donors twice
notebooks.coverage: Learn why transaction counts, unique contributors and net receipts answer different questions. Use Decimal arithmetic, retain negative adjustments, and apply an explicit synthetic amendment policy.

notebooks.title: Extract bounded article records from synthetic HTML and a sitemap
notebooks.coverage: Parse a sitemap, restrict accepted URLs to an expected origin, extract article paragraphs, and preserve provenance without fetching the network.

notebooks.title: Map synthetic sites and measure nearest-neighbor distances
notebooks.coverage: Learn to validate geographic coordinates, calculate great-circle distances, and visualize a small site inventory. Distinguish a nearest neighbor by straight-line distance from a route or a service-area assignment.

notebooks.title: Validate and inspect synthetic question pairs
notebooks.coverage: Validate a question-pair dataset, detect conflicting duplicates, assign leakage-resistant component splits, and display escaped review cards.

notebooks.title: Make notebook experiments reproducible and reviewable
notebooks.coverage: Record a minimal environment fingerprint, isolate random state, hash a synthetic input, and test a bootstrap confidence interval with reproducible resampling.

notebooks.title: Analyze synthetic sales with parameterized SQL and exact money
notebooks.coverage: Build a small relational model, calculate line revenue and refunds, and verify aggregate SQL against an independent Python calculation.

notebooks.title: Stream a synthetic scholarly corpus with bounded records
notebooks.coverage: Read JSON Lines incrementally, quarantine malformed records with line numbers, validate citation links, and aggregate without loading an entire corpus.

notebooks.title: Chunk synthetic documents with traceable boundaries and idempotent IDs
notebooks.coverage: Build a small ingestion pipeline from authored documents to overlapping word chunks, preserve offsets, and verify re-ingestion does not duplicate records.

notebooks.title: Audit and generate thumbnails from synthetic image records
notebooks.coverage: Validate image bytes and metadata, reject malformed or oversized inputs, produce bounded thumbnails, and reconcile a per-record audit summary.

notebooks.title: Preserve structure in a document translation workflow
notebooks.coverage: Segment a document, create stable translation jobs, validate responses, and reassemble a reviewable bilingual table. The default uses explicitly authored bilingual examples and tests orchestration, not machine-translation quality.

notebooks.title: Build an adversarial evaluation matrix for tool authorization
notebooks.coverage: Use wholly synthetic attack requests to distinguish prompt manipulation from enforceable backend authorization, compare an unsafe policy with a guarded dispatcher, and measure both denied attacks and allowed controls.

notebooks.title: Prepare and monitor a model customization job responsibly
notebooks.coverage: Validate synthetic chat data, construct a reproducible training manifest, estimate optimizer steps, and test a bounded job monitor against success, failure, and timeout histories before submitting GPU work.

notebooks.title: Compare retrieval experiments with evidence and abstention
notebooks.coverage: Build two deterministic answer systems, evaluate them on a held-out synthetic question set, and compare correctness, evidence, and abstention rather than reporting one flattering score.

notebooks.title: Turn HTML reference material into auditable training pairs
notebooks.coverage: Parse a synthetic HTML handbook, retain source provenance, reject unsupported answers, deduplicate records, and split by source document so related answers cannot leak across train and validation.

notebooks.title: Evaluate a real local LangGraph workflow
notebooks.coverage: Compile and execute an actual LangGraph StateGraph, evaluate route and answer contracts on synthetic cases, and demonstrate how a plausible response can hide an incorrect route.

notebooks.title: Build a reproducible artifact bundle for an air-gapped review
notebooks.coverage: Create a manifest-selected archive, verify every member and digest, and reject traversal, unexpected files, and tampering before a bundle can cross a deployment boundary.

notebooks.title: Evaluate a tool-using agent before connecting Claude
notebooks.coverage: Build a bounded tool dispatcher and a trajectory evaluator for a fictional equipment desk, then connect the same read-only contract to an optional Claude Messages API loop.

notebooks.title: Design a watsonx Orchestrate agent evaluation suite
notebooks.coverage: Author synthetic task cases, normalize recorded trajectories into a vendor-neutral contract, score routing and argument fidelity independently, and optionally run a real watsonx Orchestrate chat completion.

notebooks.title: Validate runtime context for a synthetic HR assistant
notebooks.coverage: Keep authenticated identity separate from user-provided tool arguments, compute leave balances from synthetic events, verify tenant isolation, and construct an optional Orchestrate run with explicit context.

notebooks.title: Test workflow-agent routing and session isolation
notebooks.coverage: Execute a transparent local workflow with typed result contracts, trace every stage, reject cycles, and use the same cases with an optional Langflow run endpoint.
